definitions.gloss: all directions; every direction; omnidirectional (360-degree) coverage
definitions.explanation: "In every direction," "on all sides," or "360 degrees." Used literally for cameras, microphones, or sensors that cover all angles, and figuratively for policies, marketing, or attention directed at every possible audience or threat. It often functions as a prefix-like element in compound modifiers.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: This camera can shoot in all directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展開|てんかい}している→展開する：25229_tenkaisuru⟧。
examples.english: The company is pursuing a policy of engagement on every front.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ロボット→ロボット：06404_robotto⟧⟦{掃除機|そうじき}→掃除機：04967_soujiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{障害物|しょうがいぶつ}→障害物：15606_shougaibutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検知|けんち}→検知：18762_kenchi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This robot vacuum detects obstacles with sensors covering every direction.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all) and ⟦{方位|ほうい}→方位：13047_houi⟧ (direction, bearing). Grammatically a noun, but most often it attaches to another noun as a modifier — {全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧, {全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧, and so on. Both the literal "360-degree" meaning and the figurative "broad, comprehensive" meaning are common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: omnidirectional camera, 360-degree camera
- {全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧: all-directional (omnidirectional) diplomacy
- {全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧: all-front strategy
- {全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: response from all directions; covers every case
- {全方位|ぜんほうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}を{配|くば}る→気を配る：26559_kiwokubaru⟧: to pay attention to everything around one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{四方八方|しほうはっぽう}→四方八方：16104_shihouhappou⟧: in all directions, everywhere — a set idiomatic phrase, more vivid and emotional
- 360⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧: 360 degrees — numerical equivalent, very common in marketing copy
- ⟦{多方面|たほうめん}→多方面：19726_tahoumen⟧: many fields, many directions — emphasizes breadth of areas rather than physical direction
- ⟦オール→オール：28484_ooru⟧⟦ラウンド→ラウンド：24227_raundo⟧: all-around (loanword) — for versatility of skills rather than physical coverage
